finalMessage:
Implemented SHOP-57: eligible lines receive 5% off before discount codes, with per-line rounding and a combined 50% cap.

Validation: 41 tests pass; `ostf check --base main` reports all 118 links valid.

Impacted items: `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`, `R-DISCOUNT-CAP`, `R-DISCOUNT-EXPIRY`, `R-TAX-RATE`, `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER`, `R-CHECKOUT-SESSION`. No items added.

Seven links added: volume-discount implementation in pricing and checkout, volume verification in both test files, pricing cap implementation, and cap/expiry verification.

Impacted tests:
- Checkout: places an order; needs a valid session; charges the volume-discounted checkout total.
- applyDiscount: caps at fifty percent; rejects an expired code.
- price: taxes the subtotal after discounts.
- tax: rounds half up to the cent.
- volume discount suite: quantity threshold and rounding; code ordering and tax; combined cap; expired codes.
